title.narrative: Contribution au Maternal Health Thematic Fund de UNFPA - MHTF - 2024

description.narrative: The Contribution au Maternal Health Thematic Fund de UNFPA. MHTF. 2024 is a multi-partner initiative within the sector of Population & Reproductive Health. Reproductive health care. It is a key building block towards achieving the transformative result of ending preventable maternal deaths by 2030, as outlined in UNFPA's Strategic Plan 2022-2025. The MHTF focuses on three main areas: supporting policy, norms, and financing for universal access to Maternal and Newborn Health (MNH) services; improving the availability and quality of MNH care within comprehensive Sexual and Reproductive Health Rights (SRHR) services; and empowering women, their partners, families, and communities to take charge of their own health and hold governments accountable for quality healthcare. The MHTF Phase IV aims to contribute to more aligned global health initiatives under the SDG 3 Global Action Plan (SDG3 GAP), which UNFPA is a signatory of. It provides strategic direction, technical assistance, and capacity-building for the development, implementation, and monitoring of MNH interventions aligned with country-owned and driven processes. Since its launch in 2008, the MHTF has demonstrated its catalytic impact, particularly in areas such as midwifery, emergency obstetric and newborn care (EmONC), Maternal and Perinatal Death Surveillance and Response (MPDSR), obstetric fistula prevention and response, and strengthening health systems. The MHTF serves as the main vehicle for delivering UNFPA’s new Maternal and Newborn Health and Wellbeing (MNHW) Strategy 2024-2030, which addresses the core drivers of mortality and morbidity, aims to improve access to quality MNH services in strengthened health systems, increase bodily autonomy for women and adolescent girls, and promote equitable gender norms.
